metadata.case_name: YIP MAU KEI v. WONG KAM TIM

injuries.description: back sprain with soft tissue/ paraspinal muscle involvement
source: suffered a back sprain with soft tissue/ paraspinal muscle involvement
soft tissue injury to his back, and there were only residual back symptoms with mild adverse effects.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: On and off low back pain
Episcodic bilateral big toe numbness, more on left.
Complained of tenderness at bilateral paraspinal muscles at lower lumbar.
Sensory  30% loss in anterior thigh  20% in rest of whole limb
Could stand and walk on tiptoes or heels, with complaint of back discomfort

treatments_received: physiotherapy (three sessions between March and April 2012)
intensive inpatient physiotherapy (during admission on 28-29 December 2012)
sick leave granted (94 days for 1st Accident)

losses.description: residual back symptoms with mild adverse effects
